aggregateResultsJson.title: Aggregate Results JSON
aggregateResultsJson.description: For aggregate operation: JSON array of results. Format: [{"groupByFields":{"StageName":"Negotiation"},"aggregateValue":500000,"recordCount":5},...]. Use to present pipeline breakdown to user.

ambiguous.title: Ambiguous Result
ambiguous.description: True if multiple records were found in a find/search operation.

ambiguousRelationship.title: Ambiguous Relationship
ambiguousRelationship.description: True if a parent lookup found multiple matches.

ambiguousRelationshipType.title: Ambiguous Relationship Type
ambiguousRelationshipType.description: The type of relationship that has multiple matches.

availableFieldsJson.title: Available Fields JSON
availableFieldsJson.description: JSON string containing metadata for all available fields including picklist values.

confirmationRequired.title: Confirmation Required
confirmationRequired.description: True if this is a confirmation request for delete operation.

enrichmentSuggested.title: Enrichment Suggested
enrichmentSuggested.description: True if additional fields are suggested.

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: If success is false, this contains a user-friendly error message.

groupCount.title: Group Count
groupCount.description: For aggregate operation: Number of groups in results. Example: If grouping by stage and there are 5 stages with data, groupCount is 5.

lineItemCount.title: Line Item Count
lineItemCount.description: Number of line items (products) on the opportunity.

lineItems.title: Line Items
lineItems.description: List of OpportunityLineItem records for the opportunity. Includes Product name, quantity, price, and totals.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable message describing the operation result.

moreResultsAvailable.title: More Results Available
moreResultsAvailable.description: True if the search returned the maximum number of results but there are more matching records available.

objectType.title: Object Type
objectType.description: The Salesforce object type, always "Opportunity" for Opportunity operations.

previewData.title: Preview Data
previewData.description: A JSON string representation of what would be created/updated.

previewOnly.title: Preview Only
previewOnly.description: True if this is a preview response.

queryDescription.title: Query Description
queryDescription.description: For aggregate operation: Human-readable description of the analytics query executed.

record.title: Record
record.description: The Opportunity record (for single record operations).

recordId.title: Record ID
recordId.description: The Salesforce ID of the record.

records.title: Records
records.description: List of Opportunity records (for bulk or find operations).

relatedAccountName.title: Related Account Name
relatedAccountName.description: Name of the Account associated with this Opportunity.

relationshipCandidatesJson.title: Relationship Candidates JSON
relationshipCandidatesJson.description: JSON array of candidate records when ambiguousRelationship is true.

suggestedFields.title: Suggested Fields
suggestedFields.description: List of commonly-used field API names.

totalLineItemAmount.title: Total Line Item Amount
totalLineItemAmount.description: Sum of all line item totals. May differ from Opportunity Amount if manually overridden.

totalMatches.title: Total Matches
totalMatches.description: Number of Opportunity records found in a find/search operation.

totalValue.title: Total Value
totalValue.description: For aggregate operation: Total aggregate value across all groups. For SUM Amount, this is total pipeline. For COUNT, this is total number of deals.
